```json
{

```

Frozen base commit: `fe29fbc1291b8842ed201261408a3bc690875b55`. Checked: `2026-10-03T22:52:02.308605Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/ddfcce4ee7178a1bcf87720876b3ad233fa7e1e0/review-materials/15692/base.svg) — SHA-256 `dc7a58d5a61511bdbe17e4b2f30c4b14e4eb841c1a03b965a9ba16a7feaeea96`.

Official developer icon listing hosts SVGs on paypalobjects.com; PayPal's own monogram is not listed there, but confirms paypalobjects.com as PayPal's official SVG asset host. Visible difference: Accepted icon is a filled two-tone white/blue monogram in a dark circle; candidate is the current flat outline monogram without backing — visibly different variant and presentation..
Details: Outline monogram paths, single #003087 fill and transparency identical between the source and final in source/final comparison on both themes; no detail loss.. Proportions: Standalone mark on transparency, source proportions preserved, no backing added, no transform beyond none; complete fit at 240px with even margins, recognizable at 32px on both themes. Disclosed limitation: the flat dark-blue #003087 mark has reduced contrast on the dark theme background, inherent to the official one-color variant; no recoloring is permitted..

- SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen worktree svgo.config.mjs \(sha256 f2a406e0...\), multipass: 2443 -\> 2381 bytes; optimized version selected \(visually identical to working version at 240px on both themes, confirmed by model image comparison of rsvg-convert renders\).

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-03T22:49:11.940184825Z`. - android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No Android emulator, system image or connected device installed \(SDK has cmdline-tools, platform android-37.0, build-tools 36.0.0 only\); installation outside run scope. Risk: plain single-fill paths expected to convert, but no device render observed..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same missing emulator/system-image prerequisites..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain on this Linux host..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain on this Linux host..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.

currency.basis: Exact asset referenced by the currently fetched operating paypal.com homepage, post-request capture; no unsupported refresh date or old-icon obsolescence inferred.

identity.basis: The actual live PayPal homepage designates this exact official-CDN SVG as its header-logo; double-P belongs to the PayPal record 15692. Null country metadata remains unchanged; this is brand-level representation, not a country reassignment.

assessment.independenceRationale: One official first-party publication group supplies current use, exact asset and identity. There is no claim of two independent publishers. Further independent search is unnecessary for the resolved source-use gap.
uncertainties: Accepted baseline provenance/transition date was not re-established; therefore no precise rebrand/obsolescence claim.

variant.basis: Current supported filled multicolor standalone monogram on original transparency. Compared with rejected outline, it has substantial filled geometry and bright blue/cyan areas; independent 24/32px both-theme references remain visible. No recolor, added backing, thickened strokes or emblem edits; final exact Compose Desktop gates still required.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Full original paths, three source fills and clipPath survive generated XML/offscreen Compose. Both source/final pairs agree visually; internal alpha is preserved, no missing strokes or recoloring.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Original 48x48 viewport retained; complete symbol centered in the catalog icon canvas without stretch or clipping. Bound 24/32/48px diagnostics are recognizable on white and #121212; no backing or arbitrary padding added.
candidate.rationale: Replace the rejected dark-blue thin outline with the actually used original filled three-blue double-P; preserve all source colors/geometry/transparency. This visibly changes the representation, not merely serialization, and independent source screening shows useful bright filled mass on dark.
transforms: No emblem or presentation change: working/final bytes equal the 709-byte original SVG.

SVGO 4.1.0 with frozen config SHA256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e produced 784 bytes from 709; inspected faithful independent renders, but retained smaller working/source bytes.
candidate.variant: Filled three-blue double-P on original transparency; current homepage header variant
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Accepted icon is a pale double-P inside a blue disc; final is the currently homepage-used filled three-blue monogram on transparency. proposals.reason: Fresh official PayPal homepage header uses a filled three-blue double-P SVG, not the rejected thin #003087 outline. The actual original preserves #002991/#008CFF/#60CDFF and alpha without recoloring or stroke changes. Independent librsvg references show a substantially visible filled monogram on white and #121212, including 24/32 px; exact generated-XML Compose Desktop comparisons remain coordinator work. This is a supported render-repair representation, not a claim that the baseline became obsolete at an inferred rebrand date.

sourceCandidate.rationale: Replace the rejected dark-blue thin outline with the actually used original filled three-blue double-P; preserve all source colors/geometry/transparency. This visibly changes the representation, not merely serialization, and independent source screening shows useful bright filled mass on dark.

sources.observation: Fresh HTTPS request to https://paypal.com/ redirected to the actually returned context URL https://www.paypal.com/de/home. Its data-testid=header-logo link explicitly uses paypal-mark-color_new.svg as background-image, while footer uses a separate PayPal wordmark. Thus the standalone double-P is designated as current site branding, not guessed from an unused CDN filename. Homepage receipt fetch-4c9dda8748ac4209978cf66255172207; source body retained.

Fresh HTTPS 200 original SVG, 709 bytes, viewBox 0 0 48 48, filled three-path standalone double-P with original #002991/#60CDFF/#008CFF and source clipPath. No text, raster, script, external link or mask-hole repair. Independent librsvg source/working/optimized references and actual PNG sheet inspected at 162px and native 24/32/48px on both backgrounds. All three colors/contours/alpha agree; the bright lower-P and overlap remain distinct on dark. This does not establish Compose/XML/mobile rendering.

coverage.basis: The replacement is the original filled three-blue monogram directly referenced by the current PayPal header, not the rejected thin outline. Exact source/final and Compose pairs plus bound24/32px both-theme diagnostics were inspected: complete P geometry and bright blue/cyan fills remain visible. No recoloring or stroke thickening; retained exact source bytes. Mobile unavailable is separate from these observed Desktop checks; historical audit claims are not adopted as new observations.

Chose another supported ORIGINAL representation from the live official header. Source/final comparison preserves its complete original contours/colors/alpha; actual XML/Compose output and resized24/32px diagnostics on BOTH backgrounds are legible. No arbitrary paint/stroke change, tracing or mask repair. Thus the specified contrast and representation defect is addressed, not excused as a warning.

Official URL alone was not used as suitability proof: confirmed actual header-logo role, then inspected original-vs-final and accepted-base-vs-final on both themes and actual-frame24/32px diagnostics. Filled cyan/bright-blue areas preserve recognition on dark; final is different in geometry/paint from the rejected outline. No permanent bank rejection or blanket lettering rule inferred.
